verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an API for pulling POS transactions or payouts, and never documents ledger reconciliation of daily takings. The only API reference is that POS UI extensions can query the GraphQL Admin API. That is a developer building block, not a documented transactions/payouts reconciliation capability. Generic 'integrate with your existing software' marketing and a QuickBooks Desktop POS migration page are adjacent and do not show payout data access.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger
